prompt: Listen and choose the best response.
promptZh: 請聽錄音，選出最適當的回應。
spokenPrompt: Did you mean the blank checklist or the one we completed yesterday?
spokenPromptZh: 你指的是空白檢查表，還是我們昨天填好的那份？

options.text: Send me the one with our notes already on it.
options.zh: 請把上面已寫有我們筆記的那份寄給我。
options.whyZh: 已有筆記對應昨天填過的版本，不是空白表。

options.text: There are extra pens in the drawer.
options.whyZh: 說明文具在哪裡，沒有選空白表或填好的表。

options.text: It should take about ten minutes to fill out.
options.zh: 填完應該需要十分鐘左右。
options.whyZh: 填寫時間不回答要哪一份。

explanationZh: 已有筆記對應昨天填過的版本，不是空白表。
evidence: Did you mean the blank checklist or the one we completed yesterday? / Send me the one with our notes already on it.
